verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agent identity and payments platform, not itself an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. Its docs describe a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, with a sandbox endpoint and named tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token), authenticated with the skyfire-api-key header. Setup instructions say to add the server so an agent can discover sellers and run commerce workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works; the only runtime probe tested the token REST API, not the MCP server.
